# APEX free-tier headroom estimate

Inputs: 25 streamed symbols, 300-symbol daily universe, 10 members, 3 signals/session, 20 open positions, 60 owner page views/day.

| Resource | Modelled usage | Limit (verify) | Share of limit | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vercel Hobby function invocations | 140,357 / month | 1,000,000 / month (ASSUMED) | 14.0% | https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby |
| Alpaca Basic REST requests | 40 / session (peak ≈ 9 / minute) | 200 / minute | 4.5% | https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/about-market-data-api |
| Alpaca IEX streamed symbols | 25 | 30 | 83.3% | https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/about-market-data-api |
| Supabase database size | ≈ 31.0 MB steady + 9.4 MB / month | 500 MB (warn 350, stop 450) | 34 months to 350 MB | https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-on-supabase |
| Discord messages | 44 / day | per-route rate limits (bot honours 429 retry-after) | n/a | https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/rate-limits |
| GitHub Actions minutes (max possible, model workflows) | 505 / month (455 with manual promotion), plus CI | 2,000 / month on Free, shared by ALL repos | 25.3% | https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions |
| SEC EDGAR | ≤ 2 requests / second (polite pacing) | 10 / second fair-access ceiling | ≤ 20% | https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data |

Agent API calls per day (Pi → Vercel): heartbeat 1,440, outbox_poll 2,880, config_poll 96, model_manifest_poll 32, observations_upload 28, scan_run 1, signals_and_events 12, assessments 26, catalysts 24; total ≈ 4,539.

Network egress (Pi): ≈ 12.6 MB/day, far below any home connection limit.

Notes
- Limits marked ASSUMED or "verify" change over time; check the linked page before relying on them. Nothing in APEX upgrades a plan automatically.
- GitHub Actions minutes are shared with every private repository and workflow on the account; the weekly job skips optional work when the configured budget is low.
- Supabase Free pauses after inactivity; the Pi keeps its spool and the dashboard reports the outage. Resume the project from the Supabase dashboard.
- Market data shown to other Discord members can be subject to redistribution terms even when the API itself is free (compliance switch ALLOW_EXTERNAL_MARKET_DATA_REDISPLAY stays OFF by default).


## How to read this

- **Modelled** numbers come from APEX's own schedules. Once live, compare them with measured values in the dashboard:
  - Operations → budgets, for Alpaca requests and database size.
  - Models & Automation, for Actions minutes.
- **Max possible** Actions minutes multiply each workflow's `timeout-minutes` by how often it runs. That is the worst case, not the average.
- Nothing in APEX upgrades a plan or enables paid usage. Set provider-side spending limits yourself:
  - GitHub: Billing → Spending limits → Actions **$0**.
  - Vercel Hobby and Supabase Free have no paid overage unless you upgrade.

## Scaling knobs (Settings)

| Knob | Effect |
|---|---|
| `market.slots.max_slots` | streamed symbols (≤ 30 on Alpaca Basic IEX) |
| `market.universe.*` | how many symbols the nightly scan evaluates (Alpaca REST batches of 200) |
| `market.cadence.intraday_minutes` | 15 or 30; halves intraday uploads and Alpaca calls |
| `budgets.*` | Actions minutes budget, training timeout, drift on/off, Alpaca daily request budget |
| Retention (Operations) | quote events 14 d, heartbeats 7 d, delivery attempts 30 d, feature snapshots 365 d |
